pos.personaBrief: Atalanta circulate the ball via the back three (2018/19) and lead the top-5 in shots per game (2019/20), but they are an aggressive man-oriented pressing side that is happy to attack fast, and they do not chase possession for its own sake.

pro.personaBrief: Back three circulate and use central pockets (2018/19), but the team attacks quickly after wins with three-man combinations and long-ish switches, goal-oriented and vertical.

est.personaBrief: Fluid, relational play: Papu Gomez roams as a free playmaker, centre-backs and CMs rotate into the build-up, and the front three combine around Zapata, though with a clear 3-4-3 base.

lar.personaBrief: Spielverlagerung says the central lane is the least used zone and wing-backs cover big distances to give width, so attacks go via the flanks, with wing-backs rather than wingers.

blo.personaBrief: High aggressive man-oriented press, pressing the keeper and counter-pressing quickly (2018/19, 2019/20, 2024 final); the 5-3-2 mid-block is situational.

mar.personaBrief: Man-to-man all over the pitch, wing-backs man-mark full-backs and Gasperini stuck to every Leverkusen player; zonal only in the low block.

pla.personaBrief: Same 3-4-3 and man-oriented model for nine years, imposed on players, with only tactical tweaks against the opponent (man-marking adapts to the opponent's shape).

res.personaBrief: Gasperini is described as a football purist with entertaining football, proud of how they won ('not just that we won, it's how we won'), and the team attacks even away from home.

sis.personaBrief: System over stars: the 'no divas' roster, everyone buys into the exhausting press, ordinary players developed into stars; Gomez was star but fitted the structure and later left after a row.

jog.personaBrief: Exhausting high-pressing game, wing-backs covering huge distances, strong physical profiles, yet Gasperini also values technique in the final third (Gomez, Ilicic).

bas.personaBrief: Youth policy under Gasperini: Caldara, Gagliardini, Conti, Kessie, played on training form regardless of age ('age doesn't matter'), then sold for profit.

lid.personaBrief: Gasperini is the boss with a rigid model; the Gomez row at half-time and his exit show stars are not exempt, and the group has no divas.
